name: Tuiren

attributes.attribute: another name pointing to the Uirne entry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tuiren is a cross-reference heading. The source points the reader to the Uirne entry. Uirne, also called Tuiren, was the mother of Bran and Sceolan. Those twin hounds became the favorite hunting dogs of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
